LanguageData.BI_QueenSpawnInterval: Queen: Interval to spawn additional hives
LanguageData.BI_HiveSpawnInterval: Hive: Interval to reproduce additional hives
LanguageData.BI_LetterTextInsectRaid: The {0} from a nearby insect hive colony have arrived nearby.\n\nThey are attacking immediately.
LanguageData.BI_InfestationsTip: You can choose whether or not to allow infestations from starting.
LanguageData.BI_RaidingInsectsTip: Raiding insects can enter the map when this setting is enabled.
LanguageData.BI_SwarmingHordeTip: The swarming horde event is a follow up event to an infestation. If the infestation gets too large, a massive assault on the colony can trigger.
LanguageData.BI_NotificationTip: This is the setting for the time slow and letter notification that pops up when the infestation begins.
LanguageData.BI_SpawnInitialHuntersTip: This setting controls whether the hunting groups are allowed to initially spawn from the hive when it is created.
LanguageData.BI_SpawnQueensTip: Queens can spawn from the hives when this is checked.
LanguageData.BI_SpawnNewbornsTip: If this is enabled the insects that spawn from the hives will be newborns.
LanguageData.BI_ProduceLeatherTip: When hive insects butcher corpses, they can produce leather.
LanguageData.BI_HiveLimitTip: Caution: Performance costs scale directly with number of hives. Things can get ridiculous above 30 hives!
LanguageData.BI_InitialScoreTip: Initial pawn strength is the number of groups times the initial spawn points.
LanguageData.BI_UninstallTip: This removes all traces of better infestations modifications for you to safely unsubscribe from the mod. ***BACKUP YOUR SAVE BEFORE USING!***
